Last year's Cosmic Orange iPhone 17 Pro was a huge hit as soon as it launched, but rumours suggest the iPhone 18 Pro will switch it out for a brand-new burgundy colour. Below is a preview of the new phone's selling points based on the latest leaks.

iPhone 18 Pro 主打新色預覽

Apple has always played it safe with conservative colour choices for its Pro iPhones — but that changed dramatically with the iPhone 17 Pro, which broke from the standard black-and-white palette to deliver the eye-catching Cosmic Orange that quickly became a fan favourite.

Rumours suggest Apple plans to stick with the same bold colour direction for the iPhone 18 Pro.

But this time around, instead of going with orange, the lineup is expected to come in three (possibly four) colour options:

  • Burgundy / deep cherry
  • Light blue
  • Silver
  • Possibly a dark grey

There's still no word on whether a dark grey or black will make the cut this year, but there's already solid consensus on the other three colours.

Among them, the deep cherry / burgundy is expected to be the brand-new hero colour Apple will lean on heavily in its marketing.

Leaker Fixed Focus Digital said today in a Weibo post that he had seen two different shades of the colour posted online. But he believes the correct one is the darker version — a purplish red, similar to cherry.

Some reports have only referred to the colour as "red" or "deep red", which may explain why some dummy units have ended up looking lighter and more red. Based on the leaker's account, though, what we'll actually end up with is a more purple-leaning cherry colour.

What do you think of the rumoured hero colour for the iPhone 18 Pro? Drop your thoughts in the comments.
